constraints.definition: CHECK ((status::text <> ALL (ARRAY['READY_FOR_EXECUTION'::character varying, 'IN_PROGRESS'::character varying, 'WAITING_FOR_ACCEPTANCE'::character varying, 'COMPLETED'::character varying]::text[])) OR approved_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: request_approved_time
constraints.definition: CHECK (approved_at IS NULL OR approved_at >= created_at)

constraints.name: request_completed_after_approval

constraints.name: request_requester_id_fkey

constraints.name: request_status_check

constraints.name: request_type_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (type_id) REFERENCES eas.request_type(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: workflow_instance_planned_executor_id_fkey

constraints.name: request_participant_joined_as_check

tables.name: approval_step
tables.description: Cấp duyệt 1–3; một ACTIVE; người duyệt trong cùng instance khác nhau.

constraints.name: approval_step_assignee_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (assignee_id) REFERENCES eas.app_user(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: approval_step_request_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES eas.request(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: approval_step_state_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (state::text = ANY (ARRAY['WAITING'::character varying, 'ACTIVE'::character varying, 'APPROVED'::character varying, 'REJECTED'::character varying, 'NEEDS_INFO'::character varying, 'SKIPPED'::character varying]::text[]))

constraints.name: step_instance_same_request
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (instance_id, request_id) REFERENCES eas.workflow_instance(id, request_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: step_state_times
constraints.definition: CHECK (state::text = 'WAITING'::text AND activated_at IS NULL AND closed_at IS NULL OR state::text = 'ACTIVE'::text AND activated_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_at IS NULL OR (state::text = ANY (ARRAY['APPROVED'::character varying, 'REJECTED'::character varying, 'NEEDS_INFO'::character varying]::text[])) AND activated_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_at IS NOT NULL OR state::text = 'SKIPPED'::text AND closed_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: step_time_order
constraints.definition: CHECK (closed_at IS NULL OR activated_at IS NULL OR closed_at >= activated_at)

CREATE INDEX ix_approval_decision_actor_id ON eas.approval_decision USING btree (actor_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_approval_decision_request_id ON eas.approval_decision USING btree (request_id)

tables.name: execution_attempt
tables.description: Vòng thực hiện; REWORK và đổi executor RUNNING tạo vòng mới; kết quả đã nộp bất biến.

constraints.name: attempt_closure
constraints.definition: CHECK (state::text = 'FINISHED'::text AND closure_kind IS NOT NULL AND closed_at IS NOT NULL OR state::text <> 'FINISHED'::text AND closure_kind IS NULL AND closed_at IS NULL)

constraints.name: attempt_finished_result
constraints.definition: CHECK (state::text <> 'FINISHED'::text OR closure_kind::text = 'REASSIGNED'::text AND submitted_at IS NULL OR (closure_kind::text = ANY (ARRAY['SUCCESS'::character varying, 'ACCEPTED'::character varying, 'REWORK'::character varying]::text[])) AND submitted_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: attempt_instance_same_request
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (instance_id, request_id) REFERENCES eas.workflow_instance(id, request_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: attempt_progress
constraints.definition: CHECK (state::text = 'READY'::text AND started_at IS NULL AND submitted_at IS NULL OR state::text = 'RUNNING'::text AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND submitted_at IS NULL OR state::text = 'SUBMITTED'::text AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND submitted_at IS NOT NULL OR state::text = 'FINISHED'::text AND started_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: attempt_result
constraints.definition: CHECK (submitted_at IS NULL AND result_note IS NULL AND external_reference IS NULL OR submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND result_note IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(result_note::text)) >= 10 AND length(btrim(result_note::text)) <= 4000 AND external_reference IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(external_reference::text)) >= 1 AND length(btrim(external_reference::text)) <= 200)

constraints.name: attempt_time_order
constraints.definition: CHECK ((submitted_at IS NULL OR submitted_at >= started_at) AND (closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at >= started_at) AND (closed_at IS NULL OR submitted_at IS NULL OR closed_at >= submitted_at))

constraints.name: execution_attempt_closure_kind_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (closure_kind::text = ANY (ARRAY['SUCCESS'::character varying, 'ACCEPTED'::character varying, 'REWORK'::character varying, 'REASSIGNED'::character varying]::text[]))

constraints.name: execution_attempt_executor_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (executor_id) REFERENCES eas.app_user(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: execution_attempt_request_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES eas.request(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: execution_attempt_state_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (state::text = ANY (ARRAY['READY'::character varying, 'RUNNING'::character varying, 'SUBMITTED'::character varying, 'FINISHED'::character varying]::text[]))

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX execution_attempt_id_request_id_key ON eas.execution_attempt USING btree (id, request_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX execution_attempt_instance_id_attempt_no_key ON eas.execution_attempt USING btree (instance_id, attempt_no)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX execution_attempt_pkey ON eas.execution_attempt USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX execution_inbox ON eas.execution_attempt USING btree (executor_id, state)
CREATE INDEX ix_execution_attempt_request_id ON eas.execution_attempt USING btree (request_id)
